title: Jaguar TCS Racing launch all-new Jaguar I-TYPE 7 in São Paulo to begin 2024/25 ABB FIA Formula E World Championship campaign | Jaguar TCS Racing Media Newsroom
description: Jaguar TCS Racing have unveiled its all‑new Jaguar I‑TYPE 7 on the eve of the first practice session in São Paulo, as the 2024/25 ABB FIA Formula E World Championship gets underway.The Jaguar I‑TYPE 7 has an all‑new Jaguar powertrain – inverter, Motor Generator Unit (MGU) and transmission – one of many changes that makes it a significantly more advanced race car than the 2024 Teams’ World Championship‑winning I‑TYPE 6.
